tools.name: whoami
tools.title: Who am I
tools.description: Who this connection acts as (you, and the user you act for), the workspace tools default to (id, name), the other workspaces and the teamspaces you can reach, and your history session (list_session_changes, undo_session).

tools.name: create_doc
tools.title: Create document
tools.description: Create a document. Creates a document in a workspace, optionally under a parent and with an initial Markdown body. Without afterId/beforeId it is appended as the last child.

teamspaceId.description: Hosted: the teamspace a top-level page goes into (null or absent: the creator's private section). Ignored for child pages, which share their parent's space, and in local mode.

sortKey.description: Explicit fractional key. Overrides afterId/beforeId; recorded by clients so replays converge.

SortKey.description: Fractional index key; siblings sort by (sortKey, id).

tools.name: rename_doc
tools.title: Rename document
tools.description: Rename a document.

tools.name: move_doc
tools.title: Move document
tools.description: Move a document. Moves a document (and its subtree) under a new parent, or to the top level with parentId null. Without afterId/beforeId it becomes the last child.

sortKey.description: Explicit fractional key. Overrides afterId/beforeId; recorded by clients so replays converge.

SortKey.description: Fractional index key; siblings sort by (sortKey, id).

tools.name: delete_doc
tools.title: Delete document
tools.description: Delete a document. Soft-deletes a document and its subtree. Restore it with doc.restore. Deleting a deleted document is a no-op.

tools.name: restore_doc
tools.title: Restore document
tools.description: Restore a deleted document. Restores a soft-deleted document and the part of its subtree deleted with it. If its parent is gone it is restored to the top level.

tools.name: purge_doc
tools.title: Permanently delete document
tools.description: Permanently delete a document. Permanently deletes a document in the trash, its trashed subtree, bodies and outgoing links. Links to it become unresolved. Cannot be undone.

tools.name: set_doc_properties
tools.title: Set document properties
tools.description: Set document properties. Merges `set` into the document's properties and removes the keys in `unset`.

tools.name: update_doc
tools.title: Update document body
tools.description: Update a document body. Replaces the body with markdown, or applies edits in order, all or nothing: replace swaps oldStr for newStr, insertBefore/insertAfter put newStr next to oldStr, prepend/append add newStr as a block at the start/end (also of an empty body). oldStr is matched against the Markdown from fetch_doc and must occur exactly once unless replaceAll; otherwise nothing is written and the error names the edit. expectedVersion makes a stale write a conflict.

oldStr.description: The exact text to replace or insert at. Not for prepend/append.

replaceAll.description: Every match of oldStr, not exactly one.

tools.name: fetch_doc
tools.title: Fetch document
tools.description: Get a document. Returns a document's metadata and, unless includeBody is false, its Markdown body, with `threads`: the open notes and comments left beside it, when there are any.

tools.name: list_docs
tools.title: List documents
tools.description: List the document tree. Lists documents depth-first in tree order. With rootId, lists that document's descendants only.

tools.name: list_children
tools.title: List child documents
tools.description: List a document's children. Lists the direct children of a document (or the top level when parentId is omitted) in order, each with its number of live children. Use it to load a tree level by level.

tools.name: search
tools.title: Search documents
tools.description: Search documents. Full-text search over titles and bodies. Words are matched as prefixes; all words must match. A title equal to the query comes first. When nothing matches, titles similar to the query (sharing most of its letter trigrams, so typos still find them) are returned instead, without <mark> highlights.

snippet.description: Matching excerpt; matches are wrapped in <mark></mark>.

tools.name: list_backlinks
tools.title: List backlinks
tools.description: List backlinks. Lists live documents that link to this document.

tools.name: list_block_backlinks
tools.title: List block backlinks
tools.description: List backlinks to a block. Lists live documents that link to one block (`[[Note#^blockId]]`) of this document.

tools.name: list_outgoing_links
tools.title: List outgoing links
tools.description: List outgoing links. Lists the links in this document (body first, then properties, in document order), each with the live document it resolves to or null.

tools.name: list_unlinked_mentions
tools.title: List unlinked mentions
tools.description: List unlinked mentions. Lists live documents whose text mentions this document's title without linking to it.

tools.name: list_unresolved_links
tools.title: List unresolved links
tools.description: List unresolved links. Lists links in live documents whose target does not exist (yet).

tools.name: list_doc_versions
tools.title: List document versions
tools.description: List a document's versions. Lists saved versions of a document's body, newest first.

tools.name: get_doc_version
tools.title: Get document version
tools.description: Get a document version. Returns one saved version of a document's body as Markdown.

tools.name: restore_doc_version
tools.title: Restore document version
tools.description: Restore a document version. Makes the body read as a saved version again, as a new edit. The body before the restore is kept as a version (`previousVersionId`): restore it to undo.

tools.name: list_trash
tools.title: List trash
tools.description: List the trash. Lists what is in a workspace's trash, newest first. A document deleted with its subtree is one item; restoring it restores the subtree.

tools.name: empty_trash
tools.title: Empty trash
tools.description: Empty the trash. Permanently deletes everything in a workspace's trash. Cannot be undone.

tools.name: create_attachment
tools.title: Add attachment
tools.description: Add an attachment. Records an attachment whose bytes are already stored under their SHA-256 (the Blob port locally, an upload URL when hosted). Several attachments may share the same bytes.

tools.name: delete_attachment
tools.title: Delete attachment
tools.description: Delete an attachment. Moves an attachment to the trash. Restore it with attachment.restore.

tools.name: restore_attachment
tools.title: Restore attachment
tools.description: Restore an attachment.

tools.name: purge_attachment
tools.title: Permanently delete attachment
tools.description: Permanently delete an attachment. Permanently deletes an attachment in the trash. Its bytes are removed when no other attachment uses them. Cannot be undone.

tools.name: get_attachment
tools.title: Get attachment
tools.description: Get an attachment.

tools.name: list_attachments
tools.title: List attachments
tools.description: List attachments. Lists a workspace's attachments, or one document's, newest first.

tools.name: create_thread
tools.title: Leave a note or comment
tools.description: Leave a note or a comment. Starts a thread beside a document; the body is not changed and threads are never published. A note is what the next reader should know about the text (why it says this, what it was checked against); a comment needs an answer. `quote` attaches it to a passage of the document; add `prefix` or `suffix` (the text just before or after) when the passage occurs more than once. Without `quote` it is about the whole page.

exact.description: For editors: quote is the document's text already, store it as given.

ThreadKind.description: note: context for the next reader, kept quietly beside the text. comment: expects an answer.

tools.name: reply_to_thread
tools.title: Reply to a thread
tools.description: Reply to a thread.

id.description: Client-minted id of the reply. Generated when omitted.

tools.name: resolve_thread
tools.title: Resolve a thread
tools.description: Resolve or reopen a thread. Marks a thread as dealt with: an answered comment, a note that no longer applies. It is kept, and resolved: false reopens it.

tools.name: list_sessions
tools.title: List agent sessions
tools.description: List agent sessions. Lists sessions that changed a workspace, most recent first.

tools.name: list_session_changes
tools.title: List session changes
tools.description: List a session's changes. Lists every operation a session applied, oldest first.

tools.name: undo_session
tools.title: Undo session
tools.description: Undo a session. Reverts every change a session made, newest first, as one undoable step. Changes that later edits by others touched are skipped and reported, as are changes that cannot be undone.

tools.name: create_database
tools.title: Create database
tools.description: Create a database. Creates a database: a document whose children are its rows. With documentId, turns an existing document into a database (its children become rows). Starts with a title property and one view.

id.description: Client-minted id of the new database document.

documentId.description: Turn this existing document into a database.

teamspaceId.description: Hosted: the teamspace a new top-level database goes into (null or absent: the creator's private section). Ignored with parentId or documentId, and in local mode.

sortKey.description: Explicit fractional key (recorded so replays converge).

SortKey.description: Fractional index key; siblings sort by (sortKey, id).

tools.name: get_database
tools.title: Get database
tools.description: Get a database. Returns a database's settings, live properties and views, in order.

tools.name: list_databases
tools.title: List databases
tools.description: List databases. Lists the live databases of a workspace (database documents not in the trash).

tools.name: query_database
tools.title: Query database
tools.description: Query a database. Returns one window of a view's rows (filtered, sorted, grouped), with the total and group counts. Pass viewId for a saved view, or view for an ad-hoc one (both: view overrides). Properties in filters, sorts and groups are named by id, key or name. Page with window (offset, limit; hasMore says whether rows remain). uniqueId values are numbers (shown as prefix-number, e.g. LYD-12); filters take 12 or "LYD-12".

viewId.description: A saved view's id or name.

today.description: The caller's local date for relative date filters. Default: the server's.

PropertyRef.description: A property's id, frontmatter key or name (case-insensitive).

hideEmpty.description: Hide groups with no rows (board columns).

calendarPropertyId.description: calendar: the date property placing rows

tools.name: write_database_rows
tools.title: Write database rows
tools.description: Write database rows. Creates, updates and deletes rows in one step. A row without id is created; with id it is updated (title renames it); delete: true moves it to the trash. values are keyed by property id, frontmatter key or name; relation values are row ids; select values are option names (new names become options); uniqueId values are numbers (pass 12 or "LYD-12"; new rows get the next number). unset clears properties. markdown sets the row's page content.

id.description: An existing row to update or delete.

markdown.description: The row's body; replaces the current one.

RowRef.description: A row's id or unique id ("LYD-12").

PropertyRef.description: A property's id, frontmatter key or name (case-insensitive).

uniqueId.description: e.g. "LYD-12"; null without a uniqueId property.

rows.description: One per input row, in order.

tools.name: change_database_schema
tools.title: Change database properties
tools.description: Change a database's properties. Adds, changes and removes properties in one step. update can rename (name), change the type (values are converted), the frontmatter key or the config (options, relation, number format, formula expression). Removed properties keep their values in the rows.

range.description: date: values may carry an end (start/end)

prefix.description: uniqueId: shown before the number ("LYD" → LYD-12)

databaseId.description: The database whose rows this relation points at.

reversePropertyId.description: The synced property on the other database (two-way relations).

targetPropertyId.description: A property of the related database.

PropertyRef.description: A property's id, frontmatter key or name (case-insensitive).

tools.name: change_database_views
tools.title: Change database views
tools.description: Change a database's views. Adds, changes and removes views in one step. config is merged into the view's config (filter, sorts, groupBy, columns, …; properties by id, key or name); see get_database for the current values.

PropertyRef.description: A property's id, frontmatter key or name (case-insensitive).

hideEmpty.description: Hide groups with no rows (board columns).

calendarPropertyId.description: calendar: the date property placing rows

tools.name: export_workspace
tools.title: Export workspace
tools.description: Export the workspace. Exports every page, database and attachment you can read as a zip of the folder format: Markdown files with frontmatter, a `.base` file per database, attachments and `.lydie/`. Unzipped, it opens as a vault in Lydie's local mode and in Obsidian. The trash is left out. Returns a link to download the zip.

url.description: Where to download the zip: a short-lived signed link on the hosted API, a local file or blob URL in the apps, the file it was saved to on the desktop. null when the person cancelled saving.

expiresAt.description: When `url` stops working; null if it does not.

tools.name: add_to_inbox
tools.title: Add to inbox
tools.description: Add to the inbox. Adds to the workspace's inbox, a top-level page named Inbox that is created when missing. Without a title the text is appended to the inbox as a list item (prefixed with `time`, e.g. 09:41, when given). With a title it becomes a page inside the inbox, with the text as its body and `url` as its `source` property. Needs only the inbox:write scope, so a capture-only token (a web clipper, an automation) cannot read or change anything else. Returns ids only, never content.

time.description: Local time of the capture (HH:mm), shown before an appended item.

created.description: A titled capture made a page of its own.

tools.name: run_operation
tools.title: Run an operation
tools.description: Runs any Lydie operation by id with its input, including these not listed as tools: thread.edit: Edit a thread or a reply; thread.setAnchor: Move a thread; thread.delete: Delete a thread or a reply; thread.restore: Restore a thread or a reply; thread.list: List a document's threads; activity.list: List workspace activity; database.update: Update database settings; database.delete: Turn a database back into a page; database.restore: Restore a database; database.setDefinition: Replace a database's schema and views; database.listTemplates: List row templates; database.addProperty: Add a database property; database.renameProperty: Rename a database property; database.updateProperty: Update a database property; database.changePropertyType: Change a property's type; database.moveProperty: Reorder a database property; database.deleteProperty: Delete a database property; database.restoreProperty: Restore a database property; database.addOption: Add a select option; database.updateOption: Rename or recolour a select option; database.moveOption: Reorder a select option; database.deleteOption: Delete a select option; database.createView: Create a database view; database.renameView: Rename a database view; database.duplicateView: Duplicate a database view; database.moveView: Reorder a database view; database.updateView: Update a database view; database.deleteView: Delete a database view; database.restoreView: Restore a database view; database.createRow: Create a database row; database.setValues: Set row values; database.moveRow: Move a database row; database.duplicateRows: Duplicate database rows; database.deleteRows: Delete database rows; database.restoreRows: Restore database rows. Get an operation's input schema with describe_operation.

tools.name: describe_operation
tools.title: Describe an operation
tools.description: Returns an operation's description and input and output JSON Schemas, for run_operation.
